title: Zesty Tender Argentinian Beef Empanadas
description: Tangy and tender Argentinian empanadas featuring nuts and a flaky puff pastry crust, perfect for a special occasion. This recipe is paleo-friendly and cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven.
instructions: Preheat the Dutch oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the beef, onion, garlic, and salt, and mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the almond flour and coconut oil to form a crumbly mixture.
Add the chopped pecans to the almond flour mixture and stir to combine.
Roll out the almond flour mixture to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spoon the beef mixture onto one half of the rolled out dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the dough over the beef mixture and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Place the empanadas in the preheated Dutch oven and bake for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
